title: Cality
description: Random vanilla improvements and mechanics that should already exist
body:
A Minecraft datapack/mod focused on improving vanilla gameplay with small mechanics, item buffs, and quality-of-life changes that feel natural and balanced.

--- Cality adds features designed to expand existing Minecraft mechanics instead of replacing them. The goal is simple: make underused items more interesting, improve forgotten mechanics, and add small details that make the game feel more complete while still staying true to vanilla Minecraft. # FEATURES
Trident Improvements ### Improved Impaling Impaling now deals increased damage to any mob submerged in water instead of only affecting aquatic creatures.

--- ### Channeling Weather Control Throwing a trident enchanted with Channeling from the world height limit into the sky will summon a thunderstorm.

Random Tweaks ### Torch Hit Hitting entities with a torch will briefly set them on fire.
